heroTitle: Explore an AI solutions partnership with Onsmart.AI
lead: Learn about the modalities planned for entrepreneurs, agencies, service providers, managers, and companies interested in commercializing AI solutions. Format, terms, and operation of each modality must be confirmed with the team.
contextTitle: Your work can open conversations about AI in companies
context: Entrepreneurs, agencies, service providers, and companies may be interested in working with artificial intelligence solutions. Onsmart.AI plans a program with three modalities; commercial and operational details still need validation before any enrollment.
solutionText: The briefing identifies Digital Agent, Reseller, and White Label as program modalities. This page presents these options to start a conversation, not as an offer with defined terms. Operational description, target audience, business opportunity, officially confirmed benefits, and how each modality works must be clarified by the team before engagement.
